notes: Yunus b. Ya'qub narrates a scene with Imam Sadiq; the Imam speaks («فقال أبو عبد الله: يا هشام» and «ثم قال يا هشام من علمك هذا») so he is the last link (owner ruling 5)
Hisham's speeches and the debate with Amr b. Ubayd are in the story, not transmissions; «حدثني» before يونس بن عبد الرحمن is kept as narrator
